title: Parameter-set avatar model + roster presets + in-app selection
summary: Implement the avatar as one base rig (gj-humanoid-1A) + an avatar_params parameter set (data/schemas/avatar). The 8-character roster (#024) becomes curated parameter sets on that base; in-app character selection applies a parameter set. Preset and custom (M1-AVAT-02) share the representation, so any avatar is rig-conformant by construction and the movement stack (motion matching, #043, IK, tool sockets) works unchanged. The canonical preset data is built (data/avatar/roster/, M1-AVAT-05); this ticket is the Unity runtime that loads + applies + selects it.
deliverables: unity (base rig + avatar_params application + roster presets + selection UI)

acceptance_tests.test: A selected avatar_params (preset) applies to the base rig and the character moves identically well across environments (motion matching / #043 / IK / tool sockets unchanged).
All 8 roster presets validate against data/schemas/avatar/avatar_params and are rig-conformant by construction (no per-avatar retarget).

history.event: created under AUTH #044 (custom avatars -> v1). Takes over M2-AVAT-01's roster scope, now v1 on the shared rig.
copy convention (AUTH #044 addendum): selection/store/results copy says 'your character' (not 'avatar'); see DESIGN_SYSTEM section 9.

canonical preset-roster DATA built (data/avatar/roster/: 8 schema-valid avatar_params + manifest, M1-AVAT-05). The Unity selection UI loads these; AT-2's preset validation is covered by data/avatar/roster/tests/test_roster.py. Remaining here: the C# rig application + selection UI (gj-gameplay).

gj-operator: Unity preset path built (unity/Assets/GiganticJourneys/Avatar/, assembly GJ.Avatar). The roster ships byte-identical to StreamingAssets/avatar/roster (copy_roster_to_unity.py + drift tests). AvatarParams is a strict schema-equivalent parser (biometric/extra fields rejected). CharacterRoster loads the 8 presets. AvatarAppearance applies params visual-only to the shared rig under a documented art contract (Visual scale, face blend shapes, skin/hair/outfit colours, one active variant per slot) and never touches the movement body. PlaceholderRig stands in until gj-design's rigged mesh lands. CharacterSelectView offers 'Choose your character' with 8 cards and a live preview, remembers the choice, and shows selection by mark + outline. 19/19 EditMode tests: qa/reports/M1-AVAT-01.md. Not built (hard gate): M1-AVAT-02 biometric runtime and consent copy. Remaining: final rig art + palettes, and AT-1 with motion matching/IK/sockets on the real rig. Delivered as direct commits to main; the branch name is nominal. open -> in-progress.

notes: Preset = curated avatar_params; custom = on-device-fit params (M1-AVAT-02). Same representation -> rig-conformant by construction. Player-facing selection/store/results copy says 'your character' (AUTH #044 addendum; DESIGN_SYSTEM section 9). Canonical preset data: data/avatar/roster/ (built, M1-AVAT-05).
